categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in research, development, production and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment and broad-based semiconductor equipment. Main product lines include plasma etch equipment (CCP and ICP), MOCVD equipment for LED and power device production, thin film deposition equipment (LPCVD, ALD, CVD), and other specialized equipment for advanced packaging, MEMS, and microelectromechanical systems manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) etch technology, inductively coupled plasma (ICP) etch technology, metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) for compound semiconductors, low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD), atomic layer deposition (ALD), and chemical vapor deposition (CVD) for thin film deposition. The company employs a five-stage product development process (PDP) emphasizing innovation, reliability, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are integrated circuit manufacturers, LED epitaxy producers, advanced packaging companies, MEMS manufacturers, and power device producers. Key end markets include logic chips, DRAM, 3D NAND flash memory, LED lighting and displays (including Mini-LED and Micro-LED), power semiconductors (GaN and SiC), and advanced packaging applications. The company serves both domestic Chinese and international customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with major facilities in Shanghai (headquarters and production bases), Nanchang, and the Shanghai Lingang Free Trade Zone. International operations include subsidiaries in Singapore (AMEC International), Japan (AMEC Japan), South Korea (AMEC Korea), and North America (AMEC North America). The company serves customers across Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, providing critical manufacturing equipment to semiconductor fabrication plants and LED epitaxy producers. It sources components and materials from approximately 600 global suppliers while maintaining emphasis on domestic supplier development and localization of key components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening focus on integrated circuit equipment, expanding applications in broad-based semiconductor equipment (LED, MEMS, power devices), and exploring emerging opportunities. R&D focuses on advanced etch technologies for sub-7nm logic and high-aspect-ratio structures, thin film deposition for advanced interconnects, MOCVD for next-generation displays and power devices, and new product categories including inspection equipment and environmental treatment systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of semiconductor equipment to manufacturers, with a smaller portion from spare parts, consumables, and technical support services. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of equipment following installation, debugging, and acceptance. The company employs a build-to-order production model with some inventory for common components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global etch equipment market is dominated by a few major international players. The company has established itself as a leading domestic supplier with competitive advantages in cost, service proximity, and customization. In MOCVD equipment for GaN-based LEDs, the company maintains the largest global market share since 2017. The company competes on technology advancement, product reliability, customer service, and price competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale semiconductor equipment manufacturer with 2023 revenue of approximately 6.26 billion RMB, representing 32.15% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to parent company was approximately 1.79 billion RMB in 2023, up 52.67% from 2022. The company has demonstrated consistent double-digit annual revenue growth exceeding 35% on average since 2012, with total assets of approximately 21.5 billion RMB as of end-2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced plasma etch technology enabling sub-7nm process nodes, innovative MOCVD designs achieving industry-leading wavelength uniformity and productivity, comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple semiconductor applications, strong technical support and customer proximity, and commitment to continuous innovation. The company emphasizes reliability, manufacturability, cost-effectiveness, and environmental responsibility in product design and development.
